blurb: Guests can take guided tours of the winery and vineyards, participate in wine tastings including reserve selections, and enjoy food and wine at the Gabriel Archer Tavern and Wine Pavilion. The estate includes a boutique hotel with European-themed rooms. The winery hosts private parties, corporate events, and seasonal celebrations on its 400-acre farm.
tags: Reserve Wine and Food Pairing Tour
